text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Aoharu Cup ended in a brilliant 
victory! Thanks to their remarkable 
efforts, the hearts of Riko Kashimoto and 
her teammates were saved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In honor of this achievement, Chairwoman 
Akikawa presented a special bonus: a 
"Carrot BBQ Pass"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, a supplementary prize 
befitting Team <Carrots> was also awarded.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While celebrating, they ran into Riko 
Kashimoto and her trainees. As fellow 
Trainers, they exchanged pleasantries and 
well-wishes for the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The road ahead still continues. Together, 
I and <chrname> vow to keep doing our very best 
from here on out.
